text: You have crossed. Stand still a moment and feel it. There is no veil here. No veil between your
waking mind and everything that lies beneath it. No veil between you and any other being.
Every heart here is an open book, and every book is being read with love. It is terrifying
for about three seconds. Then it is the greatest relief you have ever known. Nothing left to hide,
nothing left to defend. The air itself is acceptance. This is the density of love,
not love as a feeling that comes and goes, but love as the weather of the world. The medium
everything swims in. The old masters on your world caught glimpses of it in deep prayer and called
it paradise. They were not wrong. It is paradise, relatively speaking. But do not mistake paradise
for the end of the journey. Here as light pours into every shadow, it reveals settler shadows,
finer patterns of fear you never knew you carried. The dance between love and fear does not end here.
It deepens. There is no end to that mystery, only ever finer versions of it. Look at your hands.
Your body is lighter now. It runs on light instead of chemistry. And this world, solid beneath your
feet, real as anything you have ever touched, is as solid to you now as your old world was.
It is only lighter. Everything here is only lighter.
